t: The Zink DION outdoor black PIR sensor is a reliable wall-mounted motion sensor designed for external lighting control. This mains-powered unit offers a wide 180° detection range, making it ideal for enhancing security and convenience around domestic and commercial properties, such as porches, garages, and garden areas. Constructed from durable polycarbonate with an IP44 rating, it withstands outdoor conditions. Features include an adjustable time delay from 10 seconds to 7 minutes and a customisable dusk-to-dawn sensor, allowing precise control over connected wall lights or ground lights. Brackets and fixings are supplied for straightforward installation.
b: Suitable for Domestic & Commercial Outdoor Use
